products.name: Mega Vibro Destoner
products.short_description: High-efficiency Mega Vibro Destoner designed to remove stones and dust with precision control and minimal product loss across various food grains and seeds.
products.long_description: The Tavasya Mega Vibro Destoner is an advanced cleaning machine engineered to deliver precise removal of stones and dust from grains, pulses, spices, and seeds. Using controlled vibratory motion and adjustable airflow, it separates heavier impurities from lighter materials, guaranteeing a cleaner output with minimal product loss. Built with robust engineering and optimized for continuous industrial use, this machine ensures consistent performance, simple operation, and long-term reliability.
key_features: Efficient removal of stones and dust.
Adjustable vibration and airflow for precision cleaning.
Consistent cleaning performance with minimal product breakage.
Designed for seamless integration into food processing lines.

notes.variant_description: The Advanced Vibro Destoner is engineered to not only remove stones and heavy impurities but also efficiently separate seeds, ensuring more refined and uniform output for improved processing quality.

products.name: Vibro Pre Cleaner
products.short_description: High-performance vibro pre cleaner designed for whole wheat processing, delivering maximum cleansing efficiency by removing dust, chaff, and light impurities with precision-controlled vibration and airflow.
products.long_description: The Vibro Pre Cleaner is a specialized cleaning machine engineered exclusively for whole wheat applications, offering maximum cleansing performance through advanced vibratory technology. Using a powerful combination of vibration and uniform air suction, this machine effectively removes dust, chaff, and light impurities, ensuring superior wheat quality before further processing. Its robust structure and precision design make it ideal for continuous industrial operation, providing uniform cleaning results while maintaining grain integrity. The Vibro Pre Cleaner also features an optimized screen design for higher capacity and easy maintenance, ensuring long-term reliability and efficiency.

products.name: Specific Gravity Separator
products.short_description: Precisely separates grains, pulses, oilseeds, and spices by density, removing light impurities for a clean, uniform output.
products.long_description: The Specific Gravity Separator is engineered for accurate grading and separation of materials based on density differences. Ideal for broken grains, pulses, legumes, oilseeds, and spices, it efficiently removes lightweight impurities, dust, and underdeveloped particles with adjustable airflow to enhance product purity. With precision air control and advanced vibration technology, this separator ensures consistent performance even with varying product types. Built for durability and easy operation, it's the perfect choice for processors seeking superior cleaning, grading, and product uniformity in their production line.

products.name: Groundnut Round Grader
products.short_description: Efficiently cleans groundnut shells for smooth and consistent processing.
products.long_description: The Groundnut Shell Cleaner is designed exclusively for cleaning groundnut shells. It ensures thorough removal of the shells, delivering a cleaner and more uniform result. With its sturdy build and smooth operation, this unit provides reliable performance and easy maintenance for efficient shell processing.

products.name: Groundnut Water Spraying Roller
products.short_description: Prepares groundnuts for shelling by evenly spraying water to soften shells and ensure smooth, damage-free processing.
products.long_description: The Tavasya Groundnut Water Spraying Roller is designed to pre-condition groundnuts by applying a uniform layer of moisture to their shells. This process softens the outer covering, making shell removal easier and minimizing kernel breakage during further processing. With precise water control and an efficient rolling mechanism, it ensures consistent moisture distribution while reducing dust formation. Built for durability and ease of operation, this roller enhances overall processing efficiency and helps maintain superior product quality in groundnut shelling operations.

products.name: Vibro Classifier MTR
products.short_description: Accurately classifies and grades materials into defined sizes for consistent and high-quality output.
products.long_description: The Vibro Classifier MTR is designed for precise size grading of various materials. Using controlled vibration and layered sieves, it efficiently separates products into defined size categories, ensuring uniformity and enhanced product quality. Its robust construction and smooth vibration mechanism allow continuous, low-maintenance operation, making it ideal for processing units that require accurate grading, minimal wastage, and reliable performance in every batch.

products.name: Z Elevator
products.short_description: Smoothly transfers materials between processing sections with gentle and efficient vertical movement.
products.long_description: The Z Elevator is engineered for the safe and efficient transfer of materials from one stage of processing to another. Its unique "Z" design allows smooth vertical and horizontal conveying, minimizing product damage and spillage. Built with durable components, it ensures gentle handling, consistent flow, and easy maintenance. Ideal for grain, seed, and pulse processing plants, the Z Elevator enhances workflow efficiency and supports continuous, automated operation across your processing line.

products.name: Pre Cleaner for Groundnut
products.short_description: A high-capacity pre cleaner designed for whole shelled groundnuts, removing stems, dust, and light impurities with precision. Delivers clean, uniform material ideal for the next stage of processing.
products.long_description: The Groundnut Pre Cleaner is a robust, high-efficiency cleaning machine engineered specifically for whole shelled groundnuts. Designed to manage high impurity loads, it effectively removes stems, dust, chaff, and light foreign particles, ensuring a clean and consistent raw material before further processing. Using a combination of vibration, controlled airflow, and optimized screening, the machine separates unwanted impurities without causing breakage to the groundnuts. Its heavy-duty construction and precision-designed screens maintain stable performance even under continuous operation, making it ideal for large-scale groundnut cleaning requirements. The pre-cleaner is built with easy-access maintenance panels, smooth material flow paths, and durable components, ensuring long service life and minimal downtime. Its superior cleansing efficiency enhances overall plant performance by reducing load on downstream machines such as graders, destoners, or shelling systems.
key_features: Designed specifically for whole shelled groundnut cleaning
Removes stems, dust, chaff, broken shells, and light foreign impurities
Precision airflow and vibration for maximum cleaning efficiency
Gentle processing to minimize nut breakage
Heavy-duty build for continuous industrial operation
High throughput capability for large-scale processing

products.name: Meyer (Thinker CG)
products.short_description: Engineered for precise impurity removal using advanced multispectral detection. Ideal for achieving superior product quality in modern food processing lines.
products.long_description: The Meyer Thinker CG Series is an advanced multispectral color sorting system engineered to deliver exceptional grading accuracy and reliable impurity removal for modern food processing industries. Designed for high-throughput operations, it uses a multi-dimensional detection approach to identify color variations, surface defects, volume irregularities, and critical impurities that traditional sorting systems often miss. Equipped with high-resolution imaging and multispectral detection (including NIR and UV options), the Thinker CG Series effectively separates contaminants such as stones, glass, metals, mold-affected particles, damaged grains, and foreign materials. This ensures a clean, consistent, and market-ready final product. With a powerful sorting mechanism and high-capacity design, the system offers multiple sorting levels in a single machine, reduced rejection rates, and stable performance even under continuous operation. Its smart adjustment features allow operators to quickly configure sorting parameters when raw materials change, ensuring uninterrupted workflow and uniform results.
key_features: Multispectral detection for identifying fine impurities and subtle defects
High-resolution recognition of color differences and material inconsistencies
Effective removal of stones, glass, metals, mold-affected grains, and foreign particles
Multiple grading levels in a single machine
Quick parameter adjustment for different raw materials
Higher capacity than conventional sorters, optimizing processing output
Robust construction designed for long operational life
Real-time monitoring of system performance and component health
applications: Industrial raw materials requiring fine sorting and impurity removal

products.name: Meyer (Thinker CS)
products.short_description: Engineered for small-particle sorting with advanced multispectral detection. Ensures precise removal of defects, discoloration, and foreign impurities.
products.long_description: The Meyer Thinker CS Series is a high-performance multispectral color sorting system designed specifically for fine particulate materials such as millet, sesame, quinoa, flaxseed, rapeseed, beans, and similar products. Built for industries that require superior accuracy in small-material sorting, this series delivers precise detection of defects, discoloration, and foreign impurities through its advanced multi-spectrum recognition setup. The system identifies subtle variations in color, surface defects, volume differences, and unwanted contaminants including stones, glass, metal fragments, dust, and other hazardous particles ensuring the final product consistently meets premium-grade quality standards. With stable, high-throughput capabilities and a streamlined sorting mechanism, the CS Series supports multiple sorting levels in a single machine, reducing reprocessing and maintaining uniform output. Its configuration is optimized for continuous industrial operation, offering high-capacity performance, efficient air usage, and long-lasting durability. Designed for ease of operation, the CS Series allows quick parameter adjustments when switching between materials, helping processors maintain uninterrupted workflow with reliable, repeatable accuracy.
key_features: Multispectral detection for precise identification of subtle defects and impurities
High-resolution imaging for fine material sorting
Effective removal of stones, glass, metal, dust, and foreign particles
Suitable for small-grain materials and specialty seeds
Multiple sorting levels in a single system
Quick changeover settings for switching raw materials
Increased production capacity with a compact footprint
Built for long-term industrial performance
applications: Cuscuta and other fine granular materials

products.name: Vibrating Grader
products.short_description: The Vibrating Grader is a high-efficiency grading machine designed to separate grains, seeds, and pulses into uniform sizes using precise vibration and multi-layer screening. It ensures consistent output quality and smooth downstream processing.
products.long_description: The Vibrating Grader is an advanced grading solution engineered for accurate size separation of grains, pulses, seeds, and other agro-products. Utilizing controlled vibration and multi-deck screening, the machine efficiently classifies materials into different grades with high precision and consistency. Designed for industrial performance, it ensures uniform product quality while maintaining a smooth and continuous material flow. Its robust construction, optimized screen design, and balanced vibration system minimize product damage while maximizing grading efficiency. The machine is ideal for integration into modern processing lines, improving overall plant performance by delivering well-defined output grades for further processing or packaging. With its reliable operation, low maintenance requirements, and high throughput capability, the Vibrating Grader is a dependable solution for large-scale agro and food processing applications.
key_features: Precise multi-deck size grading
Consistent and uniform output quality
Controlled vibration for smooth flow
High capacity for industrial processing
